_comment_ConnectionStrings: Never commit real credentials. Local dev value lives in appsettings.Development.json (gitignored) or user-secrets. Production reads SQL_CONNECTION_STRING from the environment instead of this file.
_comment_Jwt: Real values come from JWT_SECRET / JWT_ISSUER / JWT_AUDIENCE environment variables. These are placeholders only, intentionally invalid so the app fails fast if the env vars are missing in a real deployment.
_comment_GoogleAuth: Real value comes from the GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID environment variable — the OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services > Credentials). Never a client SECRET here; only the public Client ID is needed to verify ID tokens.

SeedAdmin._comment: Password is never stored here. Set SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD as an environment variable before first run, or the seeder generates a random one-time password and logs it once.
